blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: For decades, Vitamin C benefits have been widely recognized and this popular vitamin has become a must in many households.

Vitamin C benefits are numerous and it is not only an antioxidant that supports immune system function and helps neutralize free radicals, it also produces collagen and provides cardiovascular support.
With just the right dosage, Vitamin C 1000mg capsules provide your body with immune and antioxidant support throughout the day.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take one to two capsules daily after a meal or as directed by your physician.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Vegetable capsule, magnesium stearate from vegetable source.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children.
Keep tightly closed in a dry place at room temperature (50-86°F or 15-30°C).
Do not use if pregnant or nursing. Stop use if adverse reactions develop.
